name: formatjavascript
description: Aplicación web para formatear archivos JavaScript, TypeScript y otros lenguajes con Prettier.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @formatjs/api && npm run build -w @formatjs/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @formatjs/shared && npm run test -w @formatjs/api && npm run test -w @formatjs/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w @formatjs/shared && npm run test:coverage -w @formatjs/api && npm run test:coverage -w @formatjs/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @formatjs/shared && npm run typecheck -w @formatjs/api && npm run typecheck -w @formatjs/web
